question: The value of 5 of 8 - 6 + [(27 - 3) ÷ 6 - 4] is:
solution:
**Given:**

5 of 8 - 6 + [(27 - 3) ÷ 6 - 4]

**Concept used:**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c7a9b9173e89d44a854cc9c8053cf1e4425472078909d5687a2dfa61a2ec670c.png] **

**Calculation:**

5 of 8 - 6 + [(27 - 3) ÷ 6 - 4]

⇒ 5 of 8 - 6 + [24 ÷ 6 - 4]

⇒ 5 of 8 - 6 + [4 - 4]

⇒ 5 of 8 - 6 + 0

⇒ 40 - 6

⇒ 34

**∴ Required answer is 34**
